name: An Accra compound

place_source.title: Wikidata: Accra (Q3761), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: An Accra compound on the coastal plain, with a shady mango, coconut and oil palms, a low wall, and patches of hard standing and garden soil. Village weavers nest near buildings; doves, crows and other common birds use the trees and open ground.

facts.text: Accra has a tropical savanna climate, Köppen Aw.
